topic: We don't lack time, we leak it: we say there is no time to train, then lose the evening to scrolling and small distractions; time isn't short, it slips away unnoticed, so we guard the hour for training the way we would guard money
figure: Seneca, Roman Stoic philosopher c. 4 BC-65 AD (On the Shortness of Life 1.3-2.1: it is not that we have a short time to live but that we waste much of it; life is long if you know how to use it; also Moral Letters 1.1-3 on time that is snatched, stolen or slips away). Paraphrased, not quoted. Single quote page, at Mintra's request
